coverage.note: Screened biology, chemistry, architecture, pharmacy, dentistry, public health and kinesiology leads. Many roster matches. Linda Trinh held out for insufficient identity signal; Christine Tran move recorded separately.

Computer science, mathematics, chemistry, planning and clinical leads screened; many already-listed names. Martino Tran already present as vp-0645. Chemistry results included students and postdocs, which were excluded.

Plant science, civil engineering, anatomy, dentistry, respiratory medicine, nephrology and psychiatry searched. Huong Nguyen is already listed; existing roster covers most strong leads. Clinical names without research-doctorate/recent-paper or stable appointment evidence were not promoted.

Medicine, neuroscience, dentistry, pharmacy and public health searched. Huy Ong verified; several clinical directory names lacked sufficient full-time/continuing role or doctorate/recent-paper evidence.

Central faculty directory, actuarial science, chemistry, chemical engineering, medicine, theology and emeritus leads screened. Dinh N. Nguyen and Trong-On Do verified; Thai/Huu Thai Nguyen is already listed. Subsite template degree claims were not accepted.
Physics, English, chemistry, economics, finance, civil engineering and optometry leads searched. Lisa Dang verified; Vinh Nguyen resolved to existing ID. Several strong leads already present.
Mathematics, computing, physiology, pediatrics, medicine, neurology and public-health leads screened. Ha Tran exact roster match. No extra candidate accepted on title alone.
Neuroscience, mathematics, social work, veterinary medicine and clinical leads screened. Minh Dang Nguyen exact existing match; Trang, Ngo, Dao and other prominent leads already rostered.

Strategy, computer science, biology, surgery, radiology and civil engineering searched. Hien Tran exact roster match. Adjunct/part-time leads excluded; Philippe Phan lacked affirmative Vietnamese identity signal.
Engineering/computing, economics, education and social-science leads screened. Uyen Trang Nguyen already listed; student and sessional leads excluded.

Chemical/materials engineering, building/civil engineering, neuroscience and emeritus leads searched. Nhat Truong Nguyen exact existing match; no historical professor mention treated as current appointment.
Medicine, radiology, engineering, microbiology and law searched. Student and affiliate leads excluded. Michel Nguyen held out because required verification incomplete.
Economics, science and Vietnamese-name searches produced no verified new candidate. Historical Ly Vu page not treated as a new identity; roster already has Ly Vu at UBC.
Ordinary urllib opened official person page successfully despite web-tool timeout. Xuan-Tan Pham verified. Kim Khoa Nguyen and Thien-My Dao already in roster.
Electrical and mechanical engineering leads searched. Tri Nhu Do verified; historical Bui-Quoc materials publications alone did not establish a current appointment.
Anthropology/tourism and existing urban studies/economics names screened. Van Troi Tran verified and distinguished from CUNY Van C. Tran.
Trung Dung Ngo verified; university directory links authoritative IslandScholar profile. Technologists, graduate instructors and coordinators excluded.
Computer-science and forestry leads examined. Duy Tin Vo employer page empty and self-report dated 2020; withheld. Qing-Lai Dang lacks affirmative Vietnamese signal.
Math directory and Asian/Pacific research-affiliate leads screened. No additional permanent primary faculty appointment verified.
Central directory and Vietnamese-name searches primarily yielded student-services staff, recruiters and graduate students; no verified new candidate.
HTTP 200 via ordinary urllib. Current appointment of existing Christine Tran recorded under possible_move. No roster edit made.
Vinh Nguyen identity already listed. Other clinical/teaching leads without required research or stability evidence were not accepted.

Additional discovery searches covered Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Western, Queen's, Guelph, Windsor, Regina, Brock, Ontario Tech, Dalhousie, Memorial, Moncton, UQAC, UQTR and smaller institutions. Results largely matched existing roster or were students/adjuncts. Coverage is a broad targeted discovery sweep, not a claim of exhaustive department-by-department enumeration. Stopped with eight solid new candidates rather than weaken evidence to reach 25.
